description: List messages held for human approval, with their full content. A key configured to require approval drafts rather than sends; a person releases it. A send that returned status 'pending_approval' is waiting here, and retrying the send does not release it. Oldest first, each with its expires_at; an expired approval drops out of the list and can no longer be decided. A decided draft leaves the list: get_thread then shows it sent (with original_text when a person edited it) or canceled, and an endpoint subscribed to the approval webhook event hears it at once.
name: list_pending_approvals
